cohort: This study included 40,213 women delivering singleton pregnancies.
finding: The VTE group was significantly associated with increased maternal age (≥35 years), HDCP, preeclampsia, maternal fever before delivery, preterm birth, and intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy.
mod_finding: Mothers in the VTE group were significantly more likely to have undergone cesarean delivery compared to the non-VTE group.
